question: What is used to make drinking water free from germs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bleaching powder**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bleaching powder, also known as calcium hypochlorite, is commonly used to disinfect drinking water.
 
• It is effective in killing bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens that can cause waterborne diseases.
 
• When added to water, bleaching powder releases chlorine, which is a powerful disinfectant.
 
• The use of bleaching powder helps in maintaining the safety and hygiene of drinking water.
 
• It is widely used in water treatment plants as well as in household water purification methods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Washing soda (Sodium carbonate)**

 
 
• It is used in laundry detergents and cleaning products.
 
• It helps in softening water and removing stains from fabrics.
 
 
 
• **Sodium hydroxide**
 
 
• Also known as lye or caustic soda, it is used in the manufacture of soap and paper.
 
• It is a strong alkaline substance used in various industrial processes.
 
 
 
• **Baking soda (Sodium bicarbonate)**
 
 
• It is commonly used in baking as a leavening agent.
 
• It also has applications in cleaning and deodorizing.
